name: Hacker News Search (Algolia)
summary: Full-text search over Hacker News stories, comments, polls and users, plus whole items with their comment trees, from the free HN Search API built on Algolia.
notes: Keyless and free. Limited to 10,000 requests per hour per IP.
Results page from 0; the response gives nbHits, nbPages, page and hitsPerPage.
The documented parameters are query, tags, numericFilters and page (plus hitsPerPage); the API is built on Algolia's search API, whose other query parameters it says are also accepted.
Timestamps for numericFilters are Unix seconds (created_at_i).

endpoints.name: Search Hacker News by relevance
endpoints.summary: Stories, comments and polls matching a query, sorted by relevance, then points, then comment count.

tags.description: Tag filter, comma-separated tags are ANDed; parenthesised ones are ORed, e.g. author_pg,(story,poll). Tags: story, comment, poll, pollopt, show_hn, ask_hn, front_page, author_USERNAME, story_ID.

numericFilters.description: Numeric conditions, comma-separated, with <, <=, =, >, >= on created_at_i (Unix seconds), points or num_comments, e.g. created_at_i>1700000000.

restrictSearchableAttributes.description: Limit matching to one attribute, e.g. url (the docs' example).

notes: tags=front_page with no query returns what is on the front page now.

endpoints.name: Search Hacker News by date
endpoints.summary: Items matching a query or filter, most recent first.

tags.description: Tag filter, comma-separated tags are ANDed; parenthesised ones are ORed, e.g. author_pg,(story,poll). Tags: story, comment, poll, pollopt, show_hn, ask_hn, front_page, author_USERNAME, story_ID.

numericFilters.description: Numeric conditions, comma-separated, with <, <=, =, >, >= on created_at_i (Unix seconds), points or num_comments, e.g. created_at_i>1700000000.

notes: Use tags=story (or comment) with numericFilters=created_at_i>X to poll for new items.

endpoints.name: Get an item with its comments
endpoints.summary: A story, comment or poll by ID with author, points, text and the full nested children tree.

endpoints.name: Get a user
endpoints.summary: Username, about text and karma of an HN user.
